info.title: edu-sharing Frontend-Server API
info.description: Endpoints the frontend server answers itself, without the repository.

Translations.description: Nested dictionary of translations: the top level keys of every scope below assets/i18n merged, the overrides of the client config applied

TranslationOverrides.description: Flat translation overrides of the client config, dotted keys (WORKSPACE.TOAST.SAVED)

get.summary: Translations of the app for one language, with the overrides of the client config
get.description: The translations of the frontend build (formerly GET /rest/config/v1/language/defaults) with the overrides of the client config on top (formerly GET /rest/config/v1/language): the ones of the context given by `context` (404 if unknown), else of the context of the domain, else the global ones. Overrides are kept per base language - de-informal gets those of de.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: id of the config context to use instead of the one of the domain - Config.contextId of GET /rest/config/v1/values, which also reflects a context an admin enforced for the session

200.description: Nested dictionary of translations: the top level keys of every scope below assets/i18n merged, the overrides of the client config applied

404.description: No translations for this language, or an unknown context

get.summary: Only the overrides of the client config for one language
get.description: For clients that load the default translations themselves (dev builds read assets/i18n directly). The same overrides getTranslations applies.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: id of the config context to use instead of the one of the domain - Config.contextId of GET /rest/config/v1/values, which also reflects a context an admin enforced for the session
